executionScopes.title: (EPIC) Workspaces: first-class execution environments attached to agents
executionScopes.description:
Extracted 2026-06-12 from Johnny-trt Phase 7 (trt.66-71) per operator decision.

VISION: a WORKSPACE is a named execution environment — container instance of the skills-sandbox image + host state dir (~/.johnny/workspaces/<workspace>/, bind-mounted; down -v safe) + connected accounts. Agents ATTACH to exactly one workspace (agents.workspace_id). Seeded non-deletable DEFAULT workspace = today's shared sandbox (state migrates to ~/.johnny/workspaces/default), so existing agents keep byte-identical behavior. Sharing is a FEATURE: one auth, many agents. Credentials are STATE not PERMISSIONS — policy (trt.38) says what an agent may run; the workspace decides as whom and against whose state. Canonical least-privilege scenario: management-meeting agent on a Finance workspace (financial-reports skill + creds), progress-meeting agent on default with calendar+tasks only.

CHAIN: wks.1 entity -> wks.2 container lifecycle -> wks.3 routing -> wks.4 account connect -> wks.5 UI -> wks.6 capstone.

GATING DIAL (operator-relaxable): wks.1 depends on Johnny-trt.34 (Phase 6 capstone), which itself waits on the human-gated Johnny-gf0 live-Meet acceptance run. If the operator wants workspaces work to start before that human gate, relax this SINGLE edge (wks.1 <- trt.34), e.g. repoint it at the remaining Phase-6 build beads.

BD HAZARD: any future bd dep add touching wks.* beads walks into the dense Johnny-trt graph via the trt.34 gate edge and HANGS bd 1.0.4 — use the JSONL import workaround (bd memories: bd-dep-add-dense-graph-hang).
